ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting by Federal Agent
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the Minneapolis shooting by a federal agent, including potential police brutality and use of force.
questions: What is the impact on community trust?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues with federal law enforcement and community relations in Minneapolis.
